# implement-spec ledger — P10.3 records-request generation

- **Spec:** docs/tickets/P10.3__records-request-gen.md (canonical §36; SIG-TASK-015/016/016a/016b/017/018, SIG-TASK-009)
- **Base branch:** devin/p10-2-detector-catalog (stacked chain)
- **Base commit:** 15d7e37
- **Feature branch:** devin/p10-3-records-request-gen
- **Package home:** tasks/ (uv workspace member `sig-tasks`, depends on sig-inference)

## Requirements (from §36)
- SIG-TASK-015 — emit ready-to-file request: target agency + records contact, correct statutory citation for jurisdiction, proven request language for record type, specific records sought.
- SIG-TASK-016 — per-jurisdiction records-law reference table, all 51 US jurisdictions: statute name/citation, initial response deadline, fee rules, appeal path, residency-required flag.
- SIG-TASK-016a — residency operationally binding: refuse to emit for non-resident filer in restricted jurisdiction (AL, AR, DE, KY, TN, VA); route task to geographic queue (§33.5); record constraint as coverage fact (§9.5/§32.2).
- SIG-TASK-016b — unknown residency → recorded as unknown, defaults to restrictive (route to local filer).
- SIG-TASK-017 — versioned templates with measured success rates; denial-producing language flagged for revision.
- SIG-TASK-018 — consent gate: no filing on a contributor's behalf without explicit consent; make clear a filed request is a public act attributable to the filer.
- SIG-TASK-009 (via records path) — resolved_no_evidence_exists writes a CoverageRecord (absence_kind=searched_not_found + sources searched). Reuse tasks.dispositions.resolve_no_evidence_exists.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1: emitted citation matches the 51-jurisdiction table for the target (deterministic).
- [ ] AC2: residency-restricted + non-resident filer → refuses to emit, routes to geographic queue, records coverage fact.
- [ ] AC3: resolved_no_evidence_exists writes CoverageRecord(searched_not_found + sources searched) via records path.
- [ ] AC4 phase-gate: CI green incl data-quality; new reqs have tests; ADR for deviation; traceability updated; risk register updated.

## Cross-cutting invariants
- §3.1 defining standard; Part VIII binding; append-only/provenance; additive/back-compat (don't break P10.1/P09.1 wire names).

## Plan / design
- Data (SIG-ENG-001, data-not-code):
  - tasks/src/tasks/data/records_law.toml — 51 jurisdictions; per-row statute name, citation, response_deadline, fee_rules, appeal_path, residency_required. table_version.
  - tasks/src/tasks/data/request_templates.toml — versioned proven-language templates per record type; template_set_version.
  - tasks/src/tasks/_data.py — cached TOML loader (mirrors connectors._data / policy._data).
- Code: tasks/src/tasks/records_request.py
  - RecordsLaw dataclass + records_law_table() + JURISDICTION_COUNT=51 + RESIDENCY_RESTRICTED_JURISDICTIONS.
  - ResidencyStatus enum (RESIDENT/NON_RESIDENT/UNKNOWN).
  - RequestTemplate + TemplateLibrary (versioned) + TemplateOutcomeLog (measured success rate + needs_revision) — SIG-TASK-017.
  - FilerConsent + ConsentNotGranted — SIG-TASK-018.
  - GeneratedRecordsRequest (ready-to-file) — SIG-TASK-015.
  - ResidencyBlock (reason, coverage fact, candidate local groups, routed) — SIG-TASK-016a/b.
  - residency_barrier_coverage() -> CoverageRecord(not_researched, search_method=residency_barrier:<citation>) — the coverage fact (not searched_not_found: SIG could not search).
  - RecordsRequestGenerator.generate(...) -> RequestGenerationResult (emitted | residency_block). Routes task into GeographicQueue/LocalGroupRegistry on block.
- Reuse tasks.dispositions.resolve_no_evidence_exists for the AC3 path (no re-impl).
- Docs: ADR-041, traceability rows, risk register rows.

## Design decisions
- Residency coverage fact uses absence_kind="not_researched" (SIG genuinely could not search — a non-resident cannot file), NOT searched_not_found. This is exactly the §32.2 point: thin evidence there must read as a legal barrier, not an absence (searched_not_found). Barrier attribution carried in search_method. Cannot add a new absence_kind (P09.1 frozen contract). Recorded in ADR-041.
- GeneratedRecordsRequest is a new value object in tasks (no dep on connectors' ingest-side RecordsRequest; tasks depends only on sig-inference).

## Test matrix
- test_tasks_records_law.py: 51 rows; exactly 6 residency-restricted == {AL,AR,DE,KY,TN,VA}; every row has citation/statute/deadline/fee/appeal; citation lookup.
- test_tasks_records_request.py: AC1 emitted citation matches table; records contact/agency/records sought present; template language + version stamped; consent required (SIG-TASK-018) refuses w/o consent + public-act notice; AC2 non-resident restricted refuses+routes+coverage fact (not_researched); unknown residency restricted also routes (016b); resident in restricted emits; non-resident in open jurisdiction emits.
- test_tasks_templates.py: versioned; success rate measured; needs_revision flags denial-heavy template (SIG-TASK-017).
- AC3: extend/confirm resolve_no_evidence_exists via records path (records_request module helper closes through the bridge).
